name: io.github.MrLinWang/umami-mcp
title: Umami Analytics (Read-only)
description: Read-only Umami analytics for self-hosted sites: traffic, referrers, sessions and events.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your self-hosted Umami instance, such as https://analytics.example.com.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Umami API key or login token with access to the sites you want to query.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: Optional IANA timezone, such as Asia/Shanghai. Defaults to UTC.
